During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]] when the native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Troxan]]s, sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; the ensuing '''conflict''' proved devastating to the Troxans. Nevertheless, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] rejected the Troxans' overtures of peace during [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] talks. The Troxans then considered a feint: they would surrender to the Republic, only to mount an insurgency against the occupiers. They dispatched a delegation to meet with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on the plant [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] to discuss the plan, but he rejected the suggestion on orders from his secret [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who wanted the Troxans to keep fighting and drain the Republic's resources. Dooku planted the suggestion in the Troxans' heads that the Confederacy would soon send reinforcements and convinced them to continue to fight.<ref name="YDR1">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 1</ref>
